lead: Sam Manekshaw was an Indian military officer, born on 3 April 1914 in Amritsar.
He died on 27 June 2008 in Wellington at the age of 94.
He has held the office of Chief of the Army Staff and Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee and has been recognised with Military Cross and Padma Bhushan.
This profile collects the Sam facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Sam Manekshaw — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sam Manekshaw was born on 3 April 1914 in Amritsar, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
He received his education at Sherwood College, Indian Military Academy, Command and Staff College and Royal College of Defence Studies.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Sam Manekshaw — Career and Professional Work
paras: Sam Manekshaw works primarily as a military officer.
He has held the following offices: Chief of the Army Staff (1969–1973) and Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee (1970–1973).
He has taken part in Bangladesh Liberation War.
